visual_anchor_inventory: main_leaf — large dominant green leaf occupying the upper half of the folio
leaf_midrib — central vein/midrib of the leaf, running vertically from the apex down to the stem
plant_stem — the vertical stem descending from the leaf base through the center of the text zone
leaf_shadow_wash — pale blue-green wash/ghost of a second leaf overlapping the lower leaf zone
root_system — complex branching root structure in the lower-left quadrant of the folio
left_text_column — text block to the left of the plant stem
right_text_column — text block to the right of the plant stem

main_leaf.description: A very large, prominently painted green leaf dominating the upper half of the folio. The leaf has a lobed outline with three to five pointed lobes. It is rendered in a vivid green wash with visible midrib and lateral veins. The leaf apex is at the top-center of the folio (y≈0). The leaf base connects to the plant_stem at approximately y≈490–510.

leaf_midrib.description: The central midrib of the main_leaf, a pale/white vertical line running from the leaf apex (y≈0, x≈505) down through the center of the leaf to its base where it connects to the stem. This midrib is the primary bisecting anchor for all <-> lines — it extends through the text zone below the leaf base as the plant_stem.

plant_stem.description: The vertical plant stem descending from the leaf base through the text zone. A narrow, elongated structure (approximately 20–30 normalized units wide) running from y≈510 down to y≈830 where it meets the root system. The stem is the physical object causing all <-> bisections in the text lines below the leaf.

leaf_shadow_wash.description: A pale blue-green wash in the mid-lower zone of the folio (approximately y≈500–700), possibly a second smaller leaf or water-pool form rendered in lighter pigment. It underlies some of the text and may slightly affect text placement in lines 9–13.

root_system.description: A complex branching root structure in the lower-left corner of the folio, drawn in brown/gold ink. The roots branch outward from the base of the plant_stem. They are entirely illustrative with no text overlay. Roots extend from approximately x≈60–420, y≈840–1000.
